what.answer: PorterChain is the operating platform that helps businesses simplify, automate, and manage local logistics. Behind that promise: professional drivers and vehicles, business portal tools, AI assistance, APIs, and dedicated logistics support across the GTA.

pricing.answer: Pricing is quote-based on vehicle class, distance, stops, and urgency (same-day vs scheduled). Your business account brings quotes, booking, tracking, and proof together — we confirm transportation capacity and price in writing before dispatch.

industries.answer: Manufacturing, construction, industrial supply, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, medical, retail, and wholesale across the GTA. PorterChain adapts to how your operations team works.

sameday.answer: Yes — same-day and urgent transportation capacity across the GTA when a driver is out, a truck is down, or demand spikes. Book from your business account or talk to a logistics specialist with pickup, drop, vehicle need, and window.

vehicles.answer: Sedan, SUV, pickup, cargo van, Sprinter van, and box trucks — each with a professional driver, matched to load, access, and urgency. Transportation is one layer of the platform; see the fleet on the business page.

merchants.answer: A PorterChain Business Account lets your ops team generate quotes, book deliveries, track shipments, download proof of delivery, view reports, and connect via APIs — with dedicated logistics support. Start on the business hub or talk to a specialist.

faq.subtitle: Common questions from Ontario businesses evaluating transportation capacity.

items.question: Do you offer same-day delivery in Toronto and the GTA?
items.answer: Yes. Same-day and urgent delivery are available across our GTA service areas subject to cut-off times, vehicle class, and capacity. Request a quote and we confirm the window.

items.question: Can you handle emergency delivery when our driver is unavailable?
items.answer: Yes. Emergency delivery and fleet overflow are core services — we dispatch matched vehicle and driver capacity, often same day.

items.question: What is intra-city logistics and do you provide it?
items.answer: Intra-city logistics is moving freight between locations within the GTA — warehouses, jobsites, stores, and clinics. We run single-stop, multi-stop, and recurring intra-city routes.

items.question: Do you provide quick or express delivery for businesses?
items.answer: Yes. Quick and express B2B delivery is available for time-sensitive freight with live tracking and proof of delivery.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We operate across the Greater Toronto Area — Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Hamilton, Kitchener-Waterloo, London, and Niagara — with route expertise on 401, 427, and 407 corridors.

items.question: What vehicles are available?
items.answer: Sedan, SUV, Pickup, Cargo Van, Sprinter Van, 16 ft Box Truck, and 20 ft Box Truck. All require a standard Ontario G Licence.

items.question: Is proof of delivery included?
items.answer: Every delivery includes photo proof, digital signature where required, GPS, and shareable tracking links.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Quote-based on vehicle class, distance, stops, urgency (same-day vs scheduled), and handling. No hidden platform fees.

sedan.description: Sedan delivery for small parcels, documents, and urban same-day runs across the GTA and Ontario. Best for low-volume, high-frequency routes with full tracking.
sedan.headline: Sedan delivery for your runs
sedan.subheadline: We use sedans for small parcels, documents, and same-day urban delivery. Reliable, trackable, and scaled to your volume.
sedan.useCases: Same-day and on-demand runs where payloads are small: documents, envelopes, small boxes, and single-parcel pickups. Ideal for pharmacy scripts, legal or professional documents, small e-commerce orders, and urban B2B drops where a car is enough. Sedans keep cost and footprint low while meeting time windows.
sedan.volumeSuitability: Best for low to moderate stop counts per run—typically a few to a dozen stops per route—with light parcels per stop. Volume can scale by adding more sedan runs or moving to SUV/van when loads grow. We match frequency (daily, weekly, or on-demand) to your needs.
sedan.whoFor: Merchants and operations that need fast, trackable urban delivery without the cost of a van or truck: same-day courier users, small retail and pharmacy routes, professional services, and businesses with recurring light-parcel runs in our service areas.
sedan.serviceAreaRelevance: We run sedan delivery across the Greater Toronto Area (Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Burlington), Kitchener-Waterloo, London, Niagara, and Oshawa–Durham. Urban and suburban coverage with consistent cut-offs and tracking. Tell us your postal codes and we’ll confirm fit.
sedan.ctaDescription: Share your routes and volume. We’ll confirm coverage and get you set up through our merchant onboarding.

suv.headline: SUV delivery when you need the space
suv.subheadline: SUVs give you more capacity than a sedan for parcels and multi-stop runs. Same reliability and tracking across our service areas.
suv.useCases: Multi-stop routes with boxes and parcels that don’t need a van: subscription boxes, medium-sized e-commerce orders, wholesale drops to cafés or retailers, and same-day runs where payload size or stop count exceeds a sedan. SUVs suit urban and suburban routes with a mix of parcel sizes.
suv.volumeSuitability: Suited to moderate stop counts and parcel volume per run—more than a sedan, without needing a van. Ideal when you have several to a dozen-plus stops per route and boxes or multiple bags per stop. We scale by adding runs or stepping up to a van when volume or palletized loads grow.
suv.whoFor: Merchants who have outgrown sedan capacity but don’t yet need a full van: subscription and D2C brands, coffee roasters and food producers doing café and retail drops, and any business with recurring multi-stop routes and medium-sized parcels in our coverage area.
suv.serviceAreaRelevance: SUV delivery runs across the GTA (Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Markham, Oakville, Burlington), Kitchener-Waterloo, London, Niagara, and Oshawa–Durham. Same service areas and standards as our sedan and van options—we pick the right vehicle for your run.
suv.ctaDescription: Share your routes and volume. We’ll confirm vehicle fit and get you set up through our merchant onboarding.

hero.title: How pricing works
hero.subtitle: We don't publish fixed rates — every merchant's volume, zones, and needs are different. Here's how we think about pricing so you know what to expect when we discuss your setup.

intro.description: Pricing is based on your actual delivery profile: where you ship, how often, and how many stops or parcels. We agree on a clear model and numbers before you commit. No surprises.

stopBased.title: Stop-based charging
stopBased.description: We can charge per stop — one fee per delivery address. This suits merchants with multiple parcels going to the same stop or simple point-to-point runs. You pay for the stops we serve, not per box.

parcelBased.title: Parcel-based charging
parcelBased.description: We can charge per parcel — one fee per shipment or per item delivered. This suits merchants whose orders are typically one parcel per stop or who want to align cost directly with volume.

areaZone.title: Area- and zone-aware pricing
areaZone.description: Where you deliver affects cost. We take your service areas and zones into account — urban, suburban, or regional — and factor that into your pricing. Same transparency: we'll confirm how your geography is reflected before you go live.

customProfile.title: Custom pricing by merchant profile
customProfile.description: Your volume, frequency, vehicle needs, and special requirements (e.g. time windows, temperature) shape a custom profile. We don't apply a single public rate card — we propose pricing that fits your operations and confirm it in writing before launch.

trust.description: We confirm pricing and terms before you commit. No hidden fees. You'll know your cost structure and can plan with confidence.
